body:
Founder real-time: 'ensure all our core repos have auto release non pre release.' New release job in release.yml, gated on push to master, auto-bumps MINOR version only, real (non-prerelease) GitHub release with the existing 3 build zips. Also found and fixed a real, pre-existing bug while verifying: tests.yml and release.yml shared the literal same concurrency group, so every push raced the two workflows against each other and whichever lost got cancelled outright -- release.yml (the only workflow carrying the release job) had gone a real stretch of today's pushes without ever completing as a result, independent of a separate known-flaky mingw/SDL2 download step. Scoped each file to its own group. SHANKPIT b8d260d.

⚓ ☃
title: Auto-release CI, matching PITVIPER's pattern -- plus a real pre-existing concurrency bug found and fixed
